title: Rain Takes Sides
body: 1998. The Docks smell like rust and orange peels. Silas Crowe — fifty, raincoat older than you — flicks a cigarette into a puddle that already knows your last name. A crate sits unclaimed under Pier 7. Somebody is coming for it. Somebody always is.

choices.text: Cut the strap. Take the crate.

outcomes.title: First mark
outcomes.body: Inside: three bottles of something that isn't wine and a ledger page with half a name burned off. Crowe doesn't smile. He nods, which is worse. The rain writes you down.
outcomes.log: Took an unclaimed crate at Pier 7. The rain noticed.

choices.text: Watch with Crowe. Learn the hour.

outcomes.title: A teacher in a wet coat
outcomes.body: You don't touch the crate. You watch who does — a kid in Rooke colors who doesn't look back. Crowe says, 'That's the lesson. Ravenport rewards the quiet thief and buries the loud one.' He buys you coffee that tastes like a dock rope.
outcomes.log: Learned the Pier 7 hour from Silas Crowe.

choices.text: Walk. Pretend the crate is weather.

outcomes.title: Clean shoes, dirty city
outcomes.body: You leave the pier. Crowe's voice follows: 'Running's a skill too. Just don't confuse it with a plan.' A block later a siren tries the air and thinks better of it.
outcomes.log: Walked away from Pier 7. The crate found other hands.

title: A Coat That Asks Questions
body: Detective Rhea Vale finds you outside a diner that never learned to close. She is not loud. She puts a photograph on the wet counter: Pier 7, last year, a figure that could be you if the rain wanted it to be. 'I don't need a confession,' she says. 'I need to know if you're going to become a problem or a person.'

outcomes.title: Vale writes in pencil
outcomes.body: You tell her you were there and you were hungry. She doesn't thank you. She files you under unfinished. The diner's neon makes your coffee look like a warning.
outcomes.log: Spoke carefully to Detective Rhea Vale. First heat, named.

choices.text: Lie like the rain is a witness.

outcomes.title: She lets the lie live
outcomes.body: Vale listens to your weather story and almost smiles. 'Cute. The city eats cute.' She leaves the photograph. The back has a case number. You are in a drawer now.
outcomes.log: Lied to Vale. The photograph stayed.

outcomes.title: Silence as a language
outcomes.body: Vale waits a full minute. Then: 'All right. We'll talk when you have a worse year.' She pays for both coffees, which feels like a warrant with manners.
outcomes.log: Met Vale's first heat with silence.

title: A Name You Don't Repeat
body: Crowe asks you onto a late ferry that doesn't print tickets. Mid-channel he says a first name — not yours — and asks you not to say it to Vale, to the Calderas, to your own sibling if they start asking smart questions. The water is black glass. Loyalty, tonight, is a sound you decide not to make.

outcomes.title: The first loyalty test
outcomes.body: You nod. Crowe looks older and younger at once. 'That's a dynasty, kid. Not the money. The silences.' Somewhere on shore a red window stays lit too long.
outcomes.log: Kept Crowe's name. First loyalty held.

choices.text: Sell the name to Vale later.

outcomes.title: A ledger with two inks
outcomes.body: You smile like a person who will sleep. You will not. Crowe believes you. Vale will too, if you let her. The ferry hits the slip harder than it should.
outcomes.log: Promised Crowe silence and planned to break it.

outcomes.title: Small on purpose
outcomes.body: You tell Crowe you don't collect names you can't protect. He almost looks proud. 'Then don't collect people either.' The city doesn't applaud. It allows it.
outcomes.log: Refused Crowe's secret. Stayed smaller on purpose.

title: Twenty-One in Ravenport
body: A cheap cake in a walk-up. Your sibling argues about the radio. Outside, the rain does the same trick it did in '98. Crowe sends a note: THE CITY HAS A SLOT FOR YOUR SURNAME. Vale's car idles half a block away and does not come in. Cass Caldera — Aurelia's sharp heir — leaves a gold-foiled card with no message. The prologue is over. The campaign is not.

choices.text: Claim the slot. Let the rain introduce you.

outcomes.title: A name that sticks
outcomes.body: You stand in the window until Vale's car leaves. The gold card goes in a drawer you will open on a worse night. Ravenport, at last, has a sentence that starts with you.
outcomes.log: Closed the prologue by claiming the family's slot in the rain.

choices.text: Stay a rumor a little longer.

outcomes.title: Rumor with a birthday
outcomes.body: You blow out the candles and do not look at the street. Crowe will be disappointed. Vale will be busy. Cass will assume you are prey. Sometimes prey lives longer.
outcomes.log: Closed the prologue quietly, still a rumor.
